053/**
054 * A {@link TypePool.Default} that produces {@link net.bytebuddy.description.type.TypeDescription}s from {@code
055 * javax.lang.model.*} constructs.
056 *
057 * <p>Notably, this approach does not cause classloading to occur.</p>
058 *
059 * @author <a href="https://about.me/lairdnelson/" target="_top">Laird Nelson</a>
060 *
061 * @see #doDescribe(String)
062 */
063public final class TypeElementTypePool extends TypePool.Default {
064

067   * Instance fields.
068   */
069

072
073  private final Domain domain;
074

078   */

083   *
084   * @param domain a {@link Domain}; must not be {@code null}
085   *
086   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code domain} is {@code null}
087   *
088   * @see #TypeElementTypePool(ClassFileVersion, TypePool.CacheProvider, Domain)
089   */
090  public TypeElementTypePool(final Domain domain) {
091    this(null, null, domain);
092  }
093
094  /**
095   * Creates a new {@link TypeElementTypePool}.
096   *
097   * @param cacheProvider a {@link TypePool.CacheProvider}; may be {@code null} in which case a new {@link
098   * TypePool.CacheProvider.Simple} will be used instead
099   *
100   * @param domain a {@link Domain}; must not be {@code null}
101   *
102   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code domain} is {@code null}
103   *
104   * @see #TypeElementTypePool(ClassFileVersion, TypePool.CacheProvider, Domain)
105   */
106  public TypeElementTypePool(final TypePool.CacheProvider cacheProvider, final Domain domain) {
107    this(null, cacheProvider, domain);
108  }

110  /**
111   * Creates a new {@link TypeElementTypePool}.
112   *
113   * @param classFileVersion a {@link ClassFileVersion}; may be {@code null} in which case the return value of an
114   * invocation of {@link ClassFileVersion#ofThisVm()} will be used instead
115   *
116   * @param cacheProvider a {@link TypePool.CacheProvider}; may be {@code null} in which case a new {@link
117   * TypePool.CacheProvider.Simple} will be used instead
118   *
119   * @param domain a {@link Domain}; must not be {@code null}
120   *
121   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code domain} is {@code null}
122   */
123  public TypeElementTypePool(final ClassFileVersion classFileVersion,
124                             final TypePool.CacheProvider cacheProvider,
125                             final Domain domain) {
126    super(cacheProvider == null ? new TypePool.CacheProvider.Simple() : cacheProvider,
127          ClassFileLocator.NoOp.INSTANCE, // no locator
128          TypePool.Default.ReaderMode.FAST); // irrelevant; doesn't read class files
129    this.domain = requireNonNull(domain, "domain");
130    this.classFileVersion = classFileVersion == null ? ClassFileVersion.ofThisVm() : classFileVersion;
131  }

135   * Instance methods.
136   */
137
138
139  /**
140   * Given a name of an only partially defined format that names a Java language array, primitive, or declared type, or
141   * the {@code void} type, returns a {@link Resolution} describing a {@link TypeDescription} corresponding to that
142   * name.
143   *
144   * <p>The {@linkplain #describe(String)} method, which this one overrides only for documentation purposes, does not
145   * document what the supplied {@code name} must be beyond this:</p>
146   *
147   * <blockquote>The name of the type to describe. The name is to be written as when calling {@link Class#getName()
148   * Class.getName()}.</blockquote>
149   *
150   * <p>We call names of this sort <dfn>type pool names</dfn>.</p>
151   *
152   * @param typePoolName a <dfn>type pool name</dfn> whose validity requirements are expressed only in <a
153   * href="https://github.com/raphw/byte-buddy/blob/byte-buddy-1.16.0/byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/pool/TypePool.java#L576-L602">source
154   * code</a>; must not be {@code null}
155   *
156   * @return a non-{@code null} {@link Resolution}
157   *
158   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code typePoolName} is {@code null}
159   *
160   * @see TypePool#describe(String)
161   *
162   * @see Class#forName(String)
163   *
164   * @see Class#getName()
165   *
166   * @see Domain#typeElement(CharSequence)
167   *
168   * @see <a
169   * href="https://github.com/raphw/byte-buddy/blob/byte-buddy-1.16.0/byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/pool/TypePool.java#L576-L602">Source
170   * code for the <code>TypePool.AbstractBase</code> class</a>
171   *
172   * @see <a href="https://github.com/raphw/byte-buddy/issues/1754">Byte Buddy issue 1754</a>
173   *
174   * @spec https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se23/html/jls-6.html#jls-6.7 Java Language Specification, section
175   * 6.7
176   *
177   * @spec https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se23/html/jls-13.html#jls-13.1 Java Language Specification, section
178   * 13.1
179   *
180   * @spec https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jvms/se23/html/jvms-4.html#jvms-4.7.9.1 Java Virtual Machine
181   * Specification, section 4.7.9.1
182   */
183  @Override // TypePool.Default
184  public final Resolution describe(final String typePoolName) {
185    // https://github.com/raphw/byte-buddy/blob/byte-buddy-1.16.0/byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/pool/TypePool.java#L576-L602
186    return super.describe(typePoolName);
187  }
188
189  @Override // TypePool.Default
190  protected final Resolution doDescribe(final String binaryName) {
191    // Note that we deliberately and I believe properly do not use the two-argument form of
192    // domain#typeElement(ModuleElement, CharSequence), since inferring the ModuleElement representing the caller here
193    // is all but impossible (except for StackWalker).
194
195    // If binaryName is the binary name of a top-level class, this will work just fine because a top level class' binary
196    // and canonical names are the same, and canonical names are what domain#typeElement(CharSequence) accepts.
197    TypeElement e = this.domain.typeElement(binaryName);
198    if (e == null) {
199      // If binaryName is not the binary name of a top-level class, then by the time we're in this method it is the
200      // binary name of an inner or nested class, and there is no perfectly reliable way to convert such a binary name
201      // into a canonical name (or, for that matter, to go the other way). For *most* cases, changing '$' to '.' to
202      // yield a valid canonical name for an inner or nested class is good enough, so that's what we do here.
203      e = this.domain.typeElement(binaryName.replace('$', '.'));
204    }
205    return
206      e == null ?
207      new Resolution.Illegal(binaryName + "; " + binaryName.replace('%', '.')) :
208      new Resolution.Simple(new TypeDescription(this.domain, e));
209  }

217  private final class TypeDescription extends LazyTypeDescription {

225    private static final String[] EMPTY_STRING_ARRAY = new String[0];
226
227
228    /*
229     * Constructors.
230     */
231
232
233    // Binary names in this mess are JVM binary names, not JLS binary names. Raph calls them "internal names" which
234    // isn't a thing. He's probably referring to the paragraph in the Java Virtual Machine Specification section 4.3.1
235    // that reads: "For historical reasons, the syntax of binary names that appear in class file structures differs from
236    // the syntax of binary names documented in JLS §13.1. In this *internal* [emphasis mine] form, the ASCII periods
237    // (.) that normally separate the identifiers which make up the binary name are replaced by ASCII forward slashes
238    // (/). The identifiers themselves must be unqualified names (§4.2.2)." On the other hand, that is not the kind of
239    // binary name returned by, for example, javax.lang.model.util.Elements#getBinaryName(TypeElement). So maybe ASM
240    // does the conversion from "real" binary name to "internal" binary name and that's what he's talking about?
241    //
242    // The consumer of these sorts of names appears to be
243    // https://asm.ow2.io/javadoc/org/objectweb/asm/signature/SignatureVisitor.html.
244    //
245    // Raph's javadoc for NamedElement#getInternalName() reads, in part: "The internal name of this byte code element as
246    // used within the Java class file format", which suggests we should look at the JVM specification for answers. See,
247    // for example, https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jvms/se23/html/jvms-4.html#jvms-4.7.9.1. Maybe those are the
248    // sorts of things meant by "internal name"?
249    //
250    // See also https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jvms/se23/html/jvms-4.html#jvms-4.2.1.
251    /**
252     * Creates a new {@link TypeDescription}.
253     *
254     * @param domain a {@link Domain}; must not be {@code null}
255     *
256     * @param e a {@link TypeElement}; must not be {@code null}
257     *
258     * @exception NullPointerException if either argument is {@code null}
259     *
260     * @spec https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jvms/se23/html/jvms-4.html#jvms-4.2.1 Java Virtual Machine
261     * Specification, section 4.2.1
262     */
263    private TypeDescription(final Domain domain, final TypeElement e) {
264      super(TypeElementTypePool.this,
265            actualModifiers(domain, e),
266            modifiers(domain, e),
267            domain.toString(domain.binaryName(e)), // "internalName"
268            binaryName(domain, e.getSuperclass()), // "superClassName"
269            interfaceBinaryNames(domain, e), // "interfaceName" (yes, singular for some reason)
270            genericSignature(domain, e), // "genericSignature"; ASM just calls it a "signature" and seems to be expecting a *type* signature in the JVM parlance
271            typeContainment(domain, e),
272            declaringTypeBinaryName(domain, e),
273            declaredTypeDescriptors(domain, e),
274            e.getNestingKind() == NestingKind.ANONYMOUS,
275            nestHostBinaryName(e),
276            nestMemberBinaryNames(e),
277            superclassAnnotationTokens(e),
278            interfaceAnnotationTokens(e),
279            typeVariableAnnotationTokens(e),
280            typeVariableBoundsAnnotationTokens(e),
281            annotationTokens(e),
282            moduleToken(domain, e),
283            fieldTokens(domain, e),
284            methodTokens(domain, e),
285            recordComponentTokens(domain, e),
286            permittedSubclassBinaryNames(domain, e),
287            classFileVersion);
288    }
289
290
291    /*
292     * Static methods.
293     */
294
295
296    private static final String binaryName(final Domain domain, final TypeMirror t) {
297      final Element e = domain.element(t);
298      return e instanceof TypeElement te ? domain.toString(domain.binaryName(te)) : null;
299    }
300
301    private static final int actualModifiers(final Domain domain, final Element e) {
302      return AccessFlags.accessFlags(e, domain);
303    }
304
305    private static final int modifiers(final Domain domain, final Element e) {
306      return AccessFlags.accessFlags(e, domain);
307    }
308
309    private static final String[] interfaceBinaryNames(final Domain domain, final TypeElement e) {
310      final List<? extends TypeMirror> ifaces = e.getInterfaces();
311      if (ifaces.isEmpty()) {
312        return EMPTY_STRING_ARRAY;
313      }
314      final String[] rv = new String[ifaces.size()];
315      for (int i = 0; i < rv.length; i++) {
316        rv[i] = binaryName(domain, ifaces.get(i));
317      }
318      return rv;
319    }
320
321    private static final String genericSignature(final Domain domain, final Element e) {
322      return Signatures.signature(e, domain);
323      // return domain.elementSignature(e);
324    }
325
326    private static final TypeContainment typeContainment(final Domain domain, final Element e) {
327      final TypeElement ee = (TypeElement)e.getEnclosingElement();
328      if (ee == null) {
329        return TypeContainment.SelfContained.INSTANCE;
330      }
331      return switch (ee.getKind()) {
332      case METHOD ->
333        new TypeContainment.WithinMethod(domain.toString(domain.binaryName((TypeElement)ee.getEnclosingElement())),
334                                         domain.toString(ee.getSimpleName()), // TODO: maybe? needs to be method's "internal name" which is just its "unqualified name" (4.2.2 JVM)
335                                         TypeDescriptors.typeDescriptor(ee.asType(), domain).descriptorString()) {};
336      case ANNOTATION_TYPE, CLASS, ENUM, INTERFACE, RECORD ->
337        new TypeContainment.WithinType(domain.toString(domain.binaryName(ee)),
338                                       ee.getNestingKind() == NestingKind.LOCAL) {}; // TODO: this is for the enclosing element, yes?
339      case PACKAGE -> TypeContainment.SelfContained.INSTANCE;
340      default -> throw new IllegalStateException(); // I guess?
341      };
342    }
343
344    private static final String declaringTypeBinaryName(final Domain domain, final TypeElement e) {
345      // TODO: triple check: getEnclosingType()? or getEnclosingElement.asType()?
346      final TypeMirror t = ((DeclaredType)e.asType()).getEnclosingType();
347      if (t == null || t.getKind() == TypeKind.NONE) {
348        return null;
349      }
350      return domain.toString(domain.binaryName((TypeElement)((DeclaredType)t).asElement()));
351    }
352
353    private static final List<String> declaredTypeDescriptors(final Domain domain, final Element e) {
354      final ArrayList<String> l = new ArrayList<>();
355      for (final Element ee : e.getEnclosedElements()) {
356        if (ee.getKind().isDeclaredType()) {
357          l.add(TypeDescriptors.typeDescriptor(ee.asType(), domain).descriptorString());
358        }
359      }
360      l.trimToSize();
361      return Collections.unmodifiableList(l);
362    }
363
364    private static final String nestHostBinaryName(final Element e) {
365      return null;
366    }
367
368    private static final List<String> nestMemberBinaryNames(final Element e) {
369      return List.of();
370    }
371
372    private static final Map<String, List<AnnotationToken>> superclassAnnotationTokens(final Element e) {

374    }
375

392    private static final List<FieldToken> fieldTokens(final Domain domain, final Element e) {
393      final ArrayList<FieldToken> l = new ArrayList<>();
394      for (final Element ee : e.getEnclosedElements()) {
395        if (ee.getKind().isField()) {
396          l.add(fieldToken(domain, (VariableElement)ee));
397        }
398      }
399      l.trimToSize();
400      return Collections.unmodifiableList(l);
401    }
402
403    private static final List<MethodToken> methodTokens(final Domain domain, final Element e) {
404      final ArrayList<MethodToken> l = new ArrayList<>();
405      for (final Element ee : e.getEnclosedElements()) {
406        if (ee.getKind().isExecutable()) {
407          l.add(methodToken(domain, (ExecutableElement)ee));
408        }
409      }
410      l.trimToSize();
411      return Collections.unmodifiableList(l);
412    }
413
414    private static final ModuleToken moduleToken(final Domain domain, Element e) {
415      while (e != null && e.getKind() != ElementKind.MODULE) {
416        e = e.getEnclosingElement();
417      }
418      if (e == null) {
419        return null;
420      }
421      final ModuleElement m = (ModuleElement)e;
422      // TODO: implement
423      final String name = domain.toString(m.getQualifiedName());
424      final Set<String> packages = Set.copyOf(m.getEnclosedElements()
425                                              .stream()
426                                              .map(p -> domain.toString(((PackageElement)p).getQualifiedName()))
427                                              .toList());
428      final int modifiers = 0; // TODO: not sure what modifiers are expected; looks like maybe just open
429      final String version = null; // ModuleElement does not expose this information
430      final String mainClass = null; // ModuleElement does not expose this information
431
432      // XXX FIXME TODO: finish implementing
433      return null;
434    }
435
436    private static final List<RecordComponentToken> recordComponentTokens(final Domain domain, final Element e) {
437      final ArrayList<RecordComponentToken> l = new ArrayList<>();
438      for (final Element ee : e.getEnclosedElements()) {
439        if (ee.getKind() == ElementKind.RECORD_COMPONENT) {
440          l.add(recordComponentToken(domain, (RecordComponentElement)ee));
441        }
442      }
443      l.trimToSize();
444      return Collections.unmodifiableList(l);
445    }
446
447    private static final List<String> permittedSubclassBinaryNames(final Domain domain, final TypeElement e) {
448      final List<? extends TypeMirror> ts = e.getPermittedSubclasses();
449      if (ts.isEmpty()) {
450        return List.of();
451      }
452      final List<String> l = new ArrayList<>(ts.size());
453      for (final TypeMirror t : ts) {
454        l.add(domain.toString(domain.binaryName((TypeElement)((DeclaredType)t).asElement())));
455      }
456      return Collections.unmodifiableList(l);
457    }
458
459    private static final FieldToken fieldToken(final Domain domain, final VariableElement e) {
460      if (!e.getKind().isField()) {
461        throw new IllegalArgumentException("e: " + e);
462      }
463      return
464        new FieldToken(domain.toString(e.getSimpleName()),
465                       AccessFlags.accessFlags(e, domain),
466                       TypeDescriptors.typeDescriptor(e.asType(), domain).descriptorString(),
467                       genericSignature(domain, e),
468                       Map.of(), // TODO: typeAnnotationTokens
469                       List.of()) {}; // TODO: annotationTokens
470    }
471
472    private static final MethodToken methodToken(final Domain domain, final ExecutableElement e) {
473      final List<? extends TypeMirror> thrownTypes = e.getThrownTypes();
474      final String[] exceptionBinaryNames;
475      if (thrownTypes.isEmpty()) {
476        exceptionBinaryNames = EMPTY_STRING_ARRAY;
477      } else {
478        exceptionBinaryNames = new String[thrownTypes.size()];
479        for (int i = 0; i < exceptionBinaryNames.length; i++) {
480          exceptionBinaryNames[i] = domain.toString(domain.binaryName((TypeElement)((DeclaredType)thrownTypes.get(i)).asElement()));
481        }
482      }
483      final ArrayList<MethodTokenSubclass.ParameterTokenSubclass> parameterTokens = new ArrayList<>();
484      for (final VariableElement p : e.getParameters()) {
485        parameterTokens.add(parameterToken(domain, p));
486      }
487      parameterTokens.trimToSize();
488      return
489        new MethodTokenSubclass(domain.toString(e.getSimpleName()),
490                                AccessFlags.accessFlags(e, domain),
491                                TypeDescriptors.typeDescriptor(e.asType(), domain).descriptorString(),
492                                genericSignature(domain, e),
493                                exceptionBinaryNames,
494                                typeVariableAnnotationTokens(e),
495                                typeVariableBoundsAnnotationTokens(e),
496                                Map.of(), // returnTypeAnnotationTokens
497                                Map.of(), // parameterTypeAnnotationTokens
498                                Map.of(), // exceptionTypeAnnotationTokens
499                                Map.of(), // receiverTypeAnnotationTokens
500                                annotationTokens(e),
501                                Map.of(), // parameterAnnotationTokens
502                                Collections.unmodifiableList(parameterTokens),
503                                null); // defaultValue
504    }
505
506    private static final MethodTokenSubclass.ParameterTokenSubclass parameterToken(final Domain domain, final VariableElement e) {
507      final int accessFlags = AccessFlags.accessFlags(e, domain);
508      return new MethodTokenSubclass.ParameterTokenSubclass(domain.toString(e.getSimpleName()), accessFlags == 0 ? null : Integer.valueOf(accessFlags));
509    }
510
511    private static final RecordComponentToken recordComponentToken(final Domain domain, final RecordComponentElement e) {
512      return
513        new RecordComponentToken(domain.toString(e.getSimpleName()),
514                                 TypeDescriptors.typeDescriptor(e.asType(), domain).descriptorString(),
515                                 genericSignature(domain, e),
516                                 Map.of(),
517                                 List.of()) {}; // annotationTokens
518    }
